parameters.query:
INSERT INTO telemetry (
  actor,
  verb,
  object,
  result,
  context,
  signature,
  recorded_at
) VALUES (
  $1::jsonb,
  $2::jsonb,
  $3::jsonb,
  $4::jsonb,
  $5::jsonb,
  $6,
  $7::timestamptz
);

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'rejected', error: $json.error_code, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() }) }}
